title: Cartwise+ Membership Fee-Waiver Look-Back Window by Payment Frequency
content:
When a Cartwise+ Membership annual term is ended early, the member fee waivers taken off the refund of the opening charge are counted over a window that depends on how steadily the member has paid.

**Rule.** A membership with at least 10 fee charges captured in the last twelve months has only the waivers of the last month counted. A membership with at least 6 and fewer than 10 fee charges captured in the last twelve months has the waivers of the last two months counted. For any other membership this rule sets no window.

## The ladder

| Fee charges captured on the membership in the last twelve months | Waivers counted |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | those of the last month |
| 6 to 9 | those of the last two months |
| 5 or fewer | no window set under this rule |

## Questions on the rule

**Which charges are counted?** Every fee charge captured on the Cartwise+ Membership in the last twelve months, whatever its fee type — first period, renewal, renewal retry or plan switch.

**Which waivers are counted?** The member fee waivers booked on the member's Cartwise Grocery Orders — the fee-waiver entries of those orders — dated inside the window, totalled by amount.

**How are the windows measured?** In whole months ending today. A row dated on the same day of the month that many months back is not counted: with today 18 August, the last month runs from 19 July, the last two months from 19 June, and the last twelve months from 19 August of the previous year.

**Where are the boundaries?** Exactly 10 captures falls on the one-month window; exactly 6 on the two-month window; 9 captures on the two-month window.

## Hypothetical illustration

A membership with 11 captured fee charges in the last twelve months; the member's orders carry waivers of 3.99 dated 5 August and 5.99 dated 10 July, today 18 August. Only the last month counts, from 19 July: the waivers counted total 3.99.
